_comment: rock_bars: a carved stone screen: a slab with 17 tall wavy hand-cut slots (none over 0.38 m at any height) between a sill and lintel with a sill and lintel, filling a 10.6 x 8.5 m gallery cross-section. Origin at the base centre, y=0 is the ground; bars span local X, thickness along local Z. One textured material (the tower's 128x128 atlas + emissive), one UV set, no skin, no animation. RockBarsCollision is one box per bar plus sill and lintel shipped as a `-colonly` node; Godot turns it into a StaticBody3D + ConcavePolygonShape3D and drops its mesh, so `surfaces` stays 1 and `max_tris` counts only what is drawn.
